name: Echo Force
author: voodoo573
description:
Rare magic weapon (requires attunement) from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. While you are attuned to and wielding this shortsword and at your hit point maximum, instead of making a melee weapon attack you can strike at the air to create a blade of magical force. Your blades of magical force are ranged spell attacks that use Strength or Dexterity (your choice), have a range of 30/60 ft., and deal 1d6 force damage. When you are not at your hit point maximum, this shortsword becomes a mundane item.

Hearth stores the shortsword itself. The 30/60-ft blades of force (1d6 force, ranged spell attack using Strength or Dexterity) only work while you are at your hit point maximum; roll them by hand.
summary: Rare shortsword that throws blades of force while you are unhurt.
